_comment: Shared by tests/extension.test.mjs (VS Code) and EffortCoreTest.kt (IntelliJ): both extensions must turn the same state.json into the same level, advice and bar.

views.name: threshold reached
views.hint: 3 struggling turns in a row: raise the thinking / reasoning effort, the task may need more deliberation. (Chat session)

views.name: twice the threshold
views.hint: 6 struggling turns in a row, more thinking did not help: switch to a more powerful model.

views.name: long clean run
views.hint: 8 clean turns in a row, the task looks easy: downgrade to a lighter model or lower the thinking effort to save tokens. (CLI session)

views.name: threshold above ten is capped
views.hint: 12 struggling turns in a row: raise the thinking / reasoning effort, the task may need more deliberation.
